## ITMediaBlock type

Represents a media block configuration for Telegram messages.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITMediaBlock = {
    type: `photo` | `video` | `audio` | `document` | `animation` | `voice` | `video_note` | `sticker` | `location` | `contact` | `group`;
    src?: string;
    srcList?: string[];
    mediaGroup?: Array<{
        type: `photo` | `video` | `audio` | `document`;
        src: string;
        caption?: string;
    }>;
    caption?: string;
    latitude?: string;
    longitude?: string;
    phone?: string;
    first_name?: string;
    last_name?: string;
    vcard?: string;
};
```

## Remarks

This type defines the structure for various media types supported by Telegram, including file-based media (photo, video, audio, document, animation, voice, video\_note, sticker), location, and contact. Pipe-delimited `src` values such as `a.jpg|b.jpg` are also exposed as `srcList` for Telegram media groups. `<g-media-group>` blocks are exposed as `mediaGroup` items and may mix photo/video items. Telegram media groups support up to 10 items and only for photo, video, audio, and document media.

## Example


```typescript
const photoMedia: ITMediaBlock = {
  type: 'photo',
  src: 'path/to/image.jpg',
  caption: 'A beautiful sunset'
};

const albumMedia: ITMediaBlock = {
  type: 'photo',
  src: 'one.jpg|two.jpg',
  srcList: ['one.jpg', 'two.jpg'],
  caption: 'Photo album'
};

const locationMedia: ITMediaBlock = {
  type: 'location',
  latitude: '37.7749',
  longitude: '-122.4194'
};

const contactMedia: ITMediaBlock = {
  type: 'contact',
  phone: '+1234567890',
  first_name: 'John',
  last_name: 'Doe'
};
```
